w: Mayor of Nairobi, Hon. Mr. Dirangu, welcomed Swamishri in evening assembly.

A couple of letters from Rajkot describing the severe water shortage prevailing in the city were read before Swamishri. The magnitude of suffering and hardship moved Swamishri. Everyone present prayed to Swamishri to bless Gujarat with bountiful rains. Swamishri replied, "When the Lord’s murti is installed here in the mandir there will be lightning and a downpour of rain." A map of Gujarat, showing the rain-less areas, was brought before Swamishri. Swamishri sprinkled water on it and requested the sadhus: "Let us all pray to God for the rains. Maharaj will have compassion and bless the land with rains..." For five minutes Swamishri, the sadhus and devotees chanted the Swaminarayan dhun and entreated the Lord to bless the dry, parched areas of Gujarat. Even while abroad, Swamishri’s heart is empathetic for those souls suffering from the severe water shortage in Gujarat.
Every person needs God and religion in his life. Without it life is useless.
God has given us this human birth not to inflict terror and pain in others, but to help others.
Anyone who endeavors under the influence of arrogance damages the society, country and its people.
When someone claims out of egotism ‘Only I know’ then he will see faults in others.

If you see single faults in others then you will become a repository of a thousand faults. Then even a good, pious person will become evil. And, if an evil person sees virtues in others then he will become virtuous and pious.
The Indian Deputy Consul General, Shri R. V. Warjri and several Indian dignitaries were invited for Swamishri's blessings and the evening celebration of Janmashtami.
The kishores sang bhajans in Swamishri's puja. In the evening they presented a lively folk dance and a quiz on Satsang basics. Finally Swamishri explained how to make oneself into a living mandir.

The evening Sunday satsang assembly commenced in the mandir assembly hall. Fourteen thousand devotees had congregrated for the assembly. Viveksagar Swami discoursed on the Harililakalpataru. Thereafter Swamishri was welcomed and honoured with garlands. Children performed a welcome dance and thereafter sadhus sang a bhajan, “Sahajãnand sindhu re…” Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Till we do not realize the glory of God we remain spiritually poor. After attaining God and Satsang our poverty vanishes. We may go through thick and thin in life because this world is full of misery. But on realizing the glory and greatness of Shriji Maharaj we will remain mentally stable. So do not worry about the ups and downs in life. Remember God.”

Today Pramukh Swami Maharaj was to leave Bochasan for Bhavnagar. When Swamishri came for the darshan of Thakorji, Subhashbhai (Dar es Salaam) said to Swamishri, "If Manki (the mare) is tired, please stay."
Swamishri said, "No, no, does one get tired like that?"
How hard it is even to say this at the age of 90!!

ds.t: Does one feel tired like that?
w: Today Pramukh Swami Maharaj was to go from Bochasan to Bhavnagar. When Swamishri came for the darshan of Thakorji, Subhashbhai (Dar es Salaam) said to Swamishri, "If Manki (the mare) is tired, please stay."
Swamishri said, "No, no, does one feel tired like that?"
How hard it is to say this sentence at the age of 90!!
Mahant Swami Maharaj was going to rest, but a devotee here wished that Swamishri would cast his glance on his dog, because he has no children. And he has accepted this dog as his own son.

The window of Swamishri's room was opened. Outside, the devotee was feeding the dog. Leading and pulling it, they brought the dog to the window where Swamishri was standing. Swamishri began looking at it lovingly. After a while, it put both its paws on the window. In between was a thin iron mesh. Just as Swamishri touches children, he touched both the dog's paws with his hands and blessed it. He gazed at it for a long time. Then he said, "In its next birth it will be born into satsang."
